ui.intro.title: Please read before you answer
ui.intro.lead: This is an anonymous survey to help improve how Nagoya Baseball Uniform Club (名古屋野球ユニ部) is run and planned.
ui.intro.note.eligibility: This survey is for people aged 18 or older.
ui.intro.note.time: It takes about {min}–{max} minutes. The number of questions varies depending on your interests and answers.
ui.intro.note.publication: Individual answers are not published. Only aggregated results will be shown on the public page. Free-text answers and detailed place of residence are never published.
ui.intro.note.admin: Individual answers may be viewed only by the single person in charge of the club, for the purpose of aggregation and improving operations.
ui.intro.note.anonymity: To protect anonymity, it is in principle not possible to verify your identity and correct or delete specific answers after you submit.
ui.intro.note.partial: Answers are sent all at once at the end. If you leave partway through, nothing is saved on the server.
ui.intro.note.notEntry: Answering this survey is not an application to join a catchball meet-up.
ui.intro.note.representativeness: Because responses are collected through social media and the web, the results do not represent the general population.
ui.intro.contact: If you have questions about taking part, please use the contact form.
ui.review.title: Review your answers
ui.review.lead: Please check your answers and submit. After submitting, it is in principle not possible to verify your identity and correct or delete specific answers.

schemaText.lowInterestAcknowledgement: Thank you. Answers saying you are not very interested in taking part right now are just as valuable for planning future events.

pure_uniform_short_route.messageBeforeProfile: That is the end of the detailed questions about running catchball meet-ups. We ask everyone about their current exercise frequency and what motivates them to exercise or start again, and then move on to the basic questions.
